detail.title: Tracking Memories Across Atoms and Reactions
detail.lede: Members of our research group are investigating how the physical world remembers past states, exploring energy limits, the emergence of objective reality, and chemical networks that retain history.

detail.title: Mapping the Mechanics of Memory
detail.lede: Since our last article, the team has worked on understanding how physical, quantum, and chemical systems hold onto their history. We have been examining the differences between simple physical persistence and the complex process of storing useful information.
